title: Bird dog
steps: Start on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your back.
Keep your hips level and your belly firm for one breath.
Return to the start and switch sides.
Do 2 sets of 6 reaches per side.
mistakes: Letting your hips tip to one side.
Lifting your head to look forward instead of down.
